blurb: Guests can enjoy private and social sightseeing boat tours and sailing adventures around Seattle's waterways, including Lake Union, Lake Washington, and Puget Sound. Experiences include private sailing charters, floating home and houseboat tours, and trips to Blake Island for day hikes and camping. Boats can be enclosed for comfort in rainy weather.

faq.q: Do I have to purchase tickets in advance?
faq.a: Tickets must be purchased in advance, and cruises often sell out quickly. To maximize your chances of getting the day and time you prefer, please book well in advance. Tickets can be purchased with a Visa, Mastercard or American Express.
